review.head: d377db7b449b570511759aa16416f40f99f38050
review.notes: Gate at d377db7: all scanners and the targeted build pass; depcheck fails with two UPWARD lines (ClassFieldTheory #258 at README lines 63,1003,1050,1185,1275,1520; AlgebraicCurves #239 at line 105). Both suppliers are roadmaps on main with the cited sections and names present there (ClassFieldTheory Layers 11 and 13, cyclicHasseNorm, isGlobalNorm_iff_isLocalNormEverywhere; AlgebraicCurves Layer 12), so the reviewer believes the lines are false positives for the board to settle; recorded as the single blocking finding R01 because the gate fails. Lean: scratch elaboration of Suggested.lean with #check on all 5 declarations matches the README; one-tactic probes (simp, aesop, tauto, exact?, inferInstance) close nothing, no padding; no statable headline is absent. Seeded sample verified at the text: 1.2, 3.9, 4.4, 4.6 (content at arXiv 1508.00178v3 §3.1; Annals pagination unchecked), 4.7, 4.9, 6.2, 6.4 (Deligne 1979 scan pp.286-287 read page by page), 7.0f and 7.6 (Milne 1983a scan pp.246, 250, 253, 261 read page by page), 7.0j, 7.12, 8.12, 8.16a, 8.17, plus the Lean docstrings' Milne CM locators. Adversarial table: 29 rows with computed values, all consistent. Cross-roadmap citations resolved on main and at open heads; two cited declaration names do not exist (R02 levelArithmetic_commensurable, R03 chevalley_finiteIndex_congruence; P3). R04 process wording (P3). R05 §3.5a re-plans general o-minimal cell decomposition and dimension owned by the other-author open roadmap StratifiedSpacesAndTameTopology (P3). Ownership: every consumer found names ShimuraVarieties as owner; ComplexMultiplicationAndExplicitReciprocity (later in the order) restates §5.1's CM types under other names, a defect on its side. Kazhdan 1983 not readable (paywalled); no sources.toml in the folder.
